title: Repo CLAUDE.md and wiki index.md — the primary auto-loaded skill-wiring surfaces — still describe the 5-skill/11-agent/S38 kit; 5 of 10 project skills absent from the phase mapping
evidence: CLAUDE.md:7 '26 skills integrated (13 superpowers + 5 project + 8 agent-skills)'; CLAUDE.md:17 Phase-7 row lists only 'wiki-update (project)' (docs-update lives only at :263); CLAUDE.md:138 'Project-level workflow skills (5 total: sprint-orient, sprint-finish, wiki-update, brainstorm-init, hook-test)'; CLAUDE.md:139 'L5 reviewer agents (11: ...)'; CLAUDE.md:146 'Current state: Sprint 38 COMPLETE (tag v0.1.0-alpha.38)'. Actual (kit-inventory AUTO block, tooling-inventory-ru.md:17, regenerated 2026-07-02): agents 18, project skills 10, superpowers 14; git log: main at S67/alpha.67. llm-wiki/wiki/index.md:144-152 'Workflow Skills' section also lists only the same 5 skills. kit/kit-inventory.sh:23-26 regenerates AUTO blocks ONLY in kit-overview-ru.md + tooling-inventory-ru.md — repo CLAUDE.md and index.md are not targets, so KIT-006's 'drift disappears as a class' does not cover the one file every session auto-loads.
why_weak: CLAUDE.md is the highest-priority wiring context loaded into EVERY session; it tells the model which skills exist per phase. A fresh session is told there are 5 project skills and that Phase 4/5/6/7 involve neither ponytail, ponytail-audit, workflow-authoring nor docs-update (phase table), plus a state anchor 29 sprints stale ('Sprint 38 COMPLETE') that contradicts SPRINT_STATE. Description-only triggering of the 5 unlisted skills then depends entirely on SKILL.md description match — exactly the 'надежда, не гарантия' failure mode the manifest work was built to eliminate.
proposed_direction: Add repo CLAUDE.md (and llm-wiki/wiki/index.md Workflow Skills section) as targets of kit-inventory.sh AUTO blocks (counts + generated skill list), fix the phase table rows (4: +ponytail; 5/6: +ponytail-audit; 7: +docs-update), replace the hardcoded 'Current state: Sprint 38' line with a pointer to SPRINT_STATE.md so it can never drift again.

title: sprint-finish Step 6b and wiki-update Step 6 still teach the mtime 'touch reviewer.md' ritual that S59 KIT-009 explicitly closed — following either skill guarantees a blocked push on every ADR-bearing sprint
mechanism: SKILL.md drifted from what the kit now does (dimension d)
evidence: .claude/skills/sprint-finish/SKILL.md:117-137 (Step 6b: 'touch ~/.claude/agents/trading-logic-reviewer.md ... Verify: latest agent mtime >= latest ADR commit time ... Pre-emptive touch = 0 retries'), :180-183 ('MUST touch ... (acknowledge)'), :192 anti-pattern 'Forgetting touch agent prompt before push'. .claude/skills/wiki-update/SKILL.md:101-108 (Step 6: touch = 'Acknowledges adr-agent-sync-check hook') and :138 anti-pattern. But the live hook (kit/hooks/adr-agent-sync-check.sh:90-94, verified identical to ~/.claude/hooks via diff → 'LIVE_MATCHES_MIRROR') now does a CONTENT check: 'KIT-009 (S59): содержательная проверка вместо mtime. `touch` больше НЕ обходит' and its block message (line 139) prints 'Просто touch файла НЕ проходит (mtime-обход закрыт в S59)'. Hook requires anchored 'ADR NNNN' text in an agent body (line 121).
why_weak: The skill that owns the ship checklist instructs an action its own gate rejects: at every ship containing ADR changes the model touches a file, pushes, gets exit-2 blocked, re-reads the hook stderr, edits an agent, retries — the exact 'налог на push' pattern the A2 analysis found in 58/75 historical blocks. The stat/mtime verification commands in Step 6b are now dead weight. Auto-memory ('github-push-auth': 'touch reviewer agent standalone before ADR push') reinforces the same stale ritual.
proposed_direction: Rewrite sprint-finish Step 6b + Hook-interactions + anti-patterns and wiki-update Step 6 to the S59 contract: grep changed ADR numbers, add an 'ADR NNNN: <one line>' entry to the relevant reviewer per the hook's own routing rule (money→security-auditor, trading→trading-logic-reviewer, ...), verify with the same grep the hook runs; update the auto-memory note.

title: ponytail and ponytail-audit (accepted ADR 0072, PHASE 4 / PHASE 5-6 triggers) have zero recorded firings across 10 sprints — adopted but dormant
evidence: ADR 0072 (decisions/0072-...md:56-57): 'триггер PHASE 4 (написание кода)' / 'триггер PHASE 5/6 (verify/review)'. grep 'ponytail' CLAUDE.md → 0 hits; grep sprint-flow-ru.md → 0 hits; grep llm-wiki/wiki/log.md → only line 2940, the S56 branch name 'chore/kit-integrate-headroom-ponytail' (adoption, not firing); grep -ri 'ponytail' llm-wiki/wiki/project/reviews/ (8 artifacts review-s59..s66 covering Phase 5/6 of 8 code-heavy kit sprints) → 0 hits. skill-manifest.sh checks no ponytail artifact. The pre-run audit (Desktop CLAUDE.md §2.3) predicted exactly this ('стреляет по описанию → может молча не выстрелить'); post-adoption evidence now confirms the prediction — residual gap not closed by S57-S67.
why_weak: ponytail-audit is the kit's only over-engineering axis ('lean/max result' — an explicit operator goal); it produced nothing in 10 sprints that added ~5000+ lines of hooks/scripts/skills. Because neither the phase table, sprint-flow-ru checklists, nor the manifest reference it, its firing depends purely on description match against a moment ('reviewing a diff before merge') that in practice is initiated by domain-reviewer dispatch, not by prose matching the description.
proposed_direction: Wire ponytail into CLAUDE.md Phase-4 row and ponytail-audit into Phase-5/6 rows + sprint-flow-ru Phase-6 checklist; cheapest observable-artifact option: have review-sNN.md require a one-line 'ponytail-audit: N findings / Lean already' entry so skill-manifest's Phase-6 check makes firing verifiable.

title: hook-test skill drifted on four axes: scope frozen at 2 of 17 hooks, documents the self-skip guard S61 removed, its Bash payloads false-fire the op-detect gates, and it ignores the S61 regression suites
mechanism: SKILL.md drifted from what the kit now does (dimension d)
evidence: (1) .claude/skills/hook-test/SKILL.md:3 covers 'adr-agent-sync-check, adr-index-sync-check, future hooks' — disk now has 17 hook .sh files, 14 wired PreToolUse(Bash) (AUTO block tooling-inventory-ru.md:17). (2) SKILL.md:49 + :75 present 'Hook self-reference ... guard skips exit 0' as expected behavior, but S61 removed self-skip from the gates: phase-advance.sh:39 and sprint-flow-check.sh:38 'НЕТ content-based self-skip', review-gate.sh:29-32 'Любой self-skip ... Теперь ДЕТЕКТ ОПЕРАЦИИ РЕШАЕТ' (only adr-* hooks retain it, adr-agent-sync-check.sh:47-50) — so the skill's expected-exit table is wrong for 13+ hooks and per :77 'If exit code deviates → hook bug. Investigate' sends the model on a false debug hunt. (3) Step 2/3 (:43, :56-61) build PAYLOAD strings containing the push literal inside a Bash tool command — the exact class-5 false-fire error-taxonomy.md:21 documents and CLAUDE.md anti-waste 'Op-detect false-fire (S65)' forbids ('НЕ передавать через Bash'). (4) kit/hooks/tests/test_phase_gate_canon.sh (38 cases) + test_state_integrity_security.py exist since S61 and are unreferenced.
why_weak: The single skill designated for hook regression testing is unusable as written: running it trips the very gates being tested, and its expectation table declares correct S61 behavior a bug. Any future hook edit that reaches for /hook-test pays a gate-block + false-debug cycle in tokens.
proposed_direction: Rewrite hook-test around the S61 test harness (bash kit/hooks/tests/test_phase_gate_canon.sh as the primary path), build payloads via a heredoc-written temp file or python3 chr() so the push/merge literal never appears in the Bash command string, replace the self-skip expectations with the per-hook truth (adr-* keep guard; gates do not), and list the 17-hook inventory by pointer to the AUTO block instead of hardcoding two names.

title: llm-wiki doc-first wiring is blind to kit/**: wiki-update triggers/steps are hardwired to src/*.py and skill-manifest's 3b advisory counts only ^src/ — kit-maintenance sprints (the current entire workload) get no llm-wiki sync trigger at all
evidence: .claude/skills/wiki-update/SKILL.md:3 'After src/ change ... Use proactively after editing src/ files'; Step 1 (:28-29) diffs only 'src/*.py' 'src/**/*.py'. kit/skill-manifest.sh:33 touched_src="...grep -cE '^src/'" — for a kit-only sprint touched_src=0 so the 3b Doc-first advisory prints nothing (lines 35-39), and :61-63 downgrades Phase 7 to advisory '·' for kit-only sprints. Contrast: docs-update SKILL.md:19-20 diffs 'src/**' AND 'kit/**' — the docs/ side covers kit, the llm-wiki side does not. The doc-first rule itself (CLAUDE.md:263, S60/S64 BINDING) demands tech pages for kit sprints too — 10 kit sprints S57-S66 relied purely on discipline for llm-wiki sync.
why_weak: The kit's own domain (kit/) is now where most work happens, yet the mechanical/advisory chain built to guarantee 'код → техстраница' only observes src/. A kit sprint that skips its llm-wiki tech page produces no WARN, no manifest dot, no skill trigger — silent regression to the pre-S60 'докой потом' state for exactly the corpus (hooks/gates) whose drift caused the S57-S66 run in the first place.
proposed_direction: Two one-line fixes: skill-manifest.sh:33 grep -cE '^(src|kit)/' (and rename the row to Doc-1st src|kit); wiki-update SKILL.md description + Step 1 add kit/** (and .claude/skills/**) to the diff paths so the description matches how kit-maintenance Phase 7 actually starts.

title: Two identically-described twins of brainstorming and verification-before-completion are registered simultaneously (superpowers:* and anthropic-skills:*) — kit overrides and phase table bind only to the superpowers names
evidence: Observed in this session's live skill registry: 'superpowers:brainstorming' and 'anthropic-skills:brainstorming' carry byte-identical descriptions ('You MUST use this before any creative work...'); same for 'superpowers:verification-before-completion' vs 'anthropic-skills:verification-before-completion'. ~/.claude/settings.json enabledPlugins has superpowers@superpowers-marketplace: true (anthropic-skills ships via CCD desktop built-ins). Kit wiring references only superpowers variants (CLAUDE.md:9-14 phase table; llm-wiki/CLAUDE.md 'Autonomous mode overrides' rows for brainstorming). Not present in any of the 5 known reports; S66 plugin research only deduped rejected third-party plugins.
why_weak: Identical descriptions make trigger selection nondeterministic; if the anthropic-skills twin fires, the llm-wiki override table ('Get design approval → Skip', 'Clarifying questions → OVERRIDDEN by brainstorm-init') and phase-table expectations written against the superpowers name may not be honored — an ambiguity in exactly the two skills the kit designates as BINDING for Phase 2 and Phase 5.
proposed_direction: Document the twin explicitly in CLAUDE.md phase table ('anthropic-skills:brainstorming = same content, same overrides apply') or, if CCD allows, disable the duplicate pair; at minimum extend the llm-wiki override rows to name both prefixes.
